definitions.fd_sqrt: Gaussian Frechet distance of square-root relative-abundance features with unbiased sample covariances; no additional outer square root.
definitions.js_p_m_variational: 0.5*mean_P(log(2*r/(1+r)))+0.25*mean_P(log(2/(1+r)))+0.25*mean_Q(log(2/(1+r))); M=(P+Q)/2, r estimates p/m. Nats; mean and sample SD over five existing RDR initializations.
definitions.prd_max_f1_sqrt: Original pair-specific 64-cluster training-only quantizers, 201-angle PRD curve maximum F1; mean and sample SD over five fixed quantizer seeds.
definitions.prevalence_mae: Mean absolute P/Q nonzero-prevalence difference across all 614 taxa.
definitions.richness_ks: Two-sample KS distance between numbers of nonzero taxa per composition.
definitions.shannon_ks: Two-sample KS distance between Shannon entropies of closed compositions; natural logarithms, 0*log(0)=0.
definitions.spearman_rmse: sqrt(mean_{j<k}((rho_P[j,k]-rho_Q[j,k])^2)); all 1225 unordered pairs among the 50 most prevalent real-training taxa. Stable index ties; float64 row closure; average-rank Spearman; no CLR or pseudocount. Undefined if any selected taxon is constant.

interpretation: All columns use the same full assessment banks, not matched subsets.
FD, marginal discrepancies, and correlation RMSE are fixed cohort statistics; no artificial repeat SD is assigned.
PRD and JS SDs quantify different conditional sources of variation and are not sampling confidence intervals.
Six metrics compare P with Q; JS compares P with M=(P+Q)/2. Only JS uses fitted RDR scores.
Correlation covers selected pairwise dependence, not all 614 taxa or the entire joint distribution.
